changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE outbox_events ( id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, aggregate_id BINARY(16) NOT NULL, aggregate_type VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, event_type VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, payload JSON NOT NULL, published BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false, created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, published_at TIMESTAMP, version INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 );
